from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,time,resource
import sympy as s
from sympy.polys.matrices import DomainMatrix
begun=time.monotonic();resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(25,26));resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(768*1024**2,)*2)
rpath=Path("reports/CLASSIFICATION_K4A_CANONICAL_FULL_AMBIENT_20261108.json");data=json.load(rpath.open())
def matrix(record):
 A=s.zeros(*record["shape"])
 for key,value in record["entries"].items():
  i,j=map(int,key.split(","));A[i,j]=s.Rational(value)
 return A
M=matrix(data["complete_sparse_matrices"]["Euler_GL5_scalar51"]);K=matrix(data["full_D_kernel_sparse"])
cert=data["certificates"]["Euler_GL5_scalar51"];rows=cert["rows"];cols=cert["columns"];block=M.extract(rows,cols)
BI=DomainMatrix.from_Matrix(block).convert_to(s.QQ).inv().to_Matrix();assert block*BI==s.eye(48)
weights=[2,1,1,0,0];selected=None
for k,free in enumerate(data["full_D_kernel_free_columns"]):
 col=data["full_original_coefficient_order"][free];i,j=col["pair"];weight=weights[i]+weights[j]-sum(a*b for a,b in zip(weights,col["exponent"]))-1
 if weight!=-1:continue
 coefficient=BI*K[rows,k];residual=K[:,k]-M[:,cols]*coefficient
 if any(residual):selected=(k,free,coefficient,residual);break
assert selected is not None
k,free,coefficient,residual=selected;index=next(i for i,z in enumerate(residual)if z)
functional=s.zeros(1,150);functional[0,index]=1;adjust=M[index,cols]*BI
for a,i in enumerate(rows):functional[0,i]-=adjust[a]
assert functional*M==s.zeros(1,51);nonzero=(functional*K[:,k])[0];assert nonzero!=0
c,a,b,u,v=xx=s.symbols("c a b u v");N=s.zeros(5)
for column,value in enumerate(K[:,k]):
 if not value:continue
 z=data["full_original_coefficient_order"][column];i,j=z["pair"];N[i,j]+=value*s.prod(t**e for t,e in zip(xx,z["exponent"]));N[j,i]=N[i,j]*-1
for column,value in enumerate(K[:,k]):
 if value:
  z=data["full_original_coefficient_order"][column];i,j=z["pair"];assert weights[i]+weights[j]-sum(a*b for a,b in zip(weights,z["exponent"]))-1==-1

result={"task_id":"E_reduced_nonnormal","all_passed":True,"operation":"Read only already certified Dkernel/M fixed48block; no newpoint/operator/rank/minor/Jacobi calculation", "kernel_basis_index":k,"kernel_free_coefficient_column":free,"torus_character":-1,"N_brackets":{f"{i},{j}":str(N[i,j])for i in range(5)for j in range(i+1,5)if N[i,j]},"M_existing_independent_rows":rows,"M_existing_independent_columns":cols,"M_existing_block_solution_coefficients":{str(i):str(z)for i,z in enumerate(coefficient)if z},"full150_non_group_residual":{str(i):str(z)for i,z in enumerate(residual)if z},"annihilator_of_all51_actual_columns":{str(i):str(z)for i,z in enumerate(functional)if z},"annihilator_on_selected_N":str(nonzero),"one_residual_nonzero_coordinate":index,"input_report_sha256":hashlib.sha256(rpath.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"inline_source":job["inline_source"],"seconds":time.monotonic()-begun,"next_step":"Handcheck selectedONE N selfJacobi only; no highernormal/jet extension"}
out=Path("reports/CLASSIFICATION_K4A_EXISTING_MATRIX_NORMAL_READBACK_20261108.json")
with out.open("x")as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2);f.write("\n")
